simple.meaning: תֹּמֶר (tômer) is a Hebrew word meaning “a palm trunk.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תֹּמֶר (H8560) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 4:5, with occurrences in Judges, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תֹּמֶר (H8560) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תֹּמֶר (H8560) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תֹּמֶר (tômer) / H8560 is traced through Judges 4:5, Jeremiah 10:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
